newsitem.title: USA: Harris Corp sees growth in net, revs.
newsitem.headline: Harris Corp sees growth in net, revs.

text.p: Harris Corp said on Wednesday it expects continued double-digit earnings growth and some acceleration in revenue growth in the second half of fiscal 1997.

Harris Corp reported earnings for the second quarter ended December 31, 1996 of $1.17 a share on revenues of $945.9 million, compared with $1.03 a share on revenues of $916.6 million. The company said that, even though commodity prices are still lagging, overall demand is on the rise, which should lead to improved sales and profit growth in the Semiconductor Sector in the second half of the year compared with the first half.
